root_cause: sandbox mtime anomaly: edited source files do not invalidate __pycache__, pytest runs stale bytecode
fix: run pytest with -B -p no:cacheprovider and delete __pycache__ before verification

root_cause: prompt instructions contained the literal string <context>, colliding with the context-block delimiter so the mock LLM extracted instructions instead of context
fix: use unique delimiter <kb-context> that never appears in instruction text

root_cause: FastAPI route annotated with Envelope | StreamingResponse union return type fails route collection
fix: set response_model=None in decorator and drop the union annotation

root_cause: literal BMP symbol characters in a regex source file get mangled by console code pages, producing bad character range errors
fix: detect emoji via ord() codepoint ranges, never literal emoji characters in source
